name: parallel-write-locks-cover-apply-patch
description: Per-path parallel write locks (write_locks.rs) cover edit_file/write_file/apply_patch via apply_patch_operations_locked: lock every patch path (incl. rename targets) up front, hold for the whole call. Regression tests use SlowWriteMockSandbox to force the read-modify-write race; verify the test is sharp by running it with locks disabled (must fail).

content: Cycle = select -> build -> code-review -> (improve-codebase-architecture) -> integrate -> MANDATORY reflection. Reflection self-edits the skill, records learnings to mulch, files new demands as seeds autonomously; pivotal forks trigger grill-with-docs instead of guessing. Upstream offers parked until upstream reacts (f251).

All Rust work follows the rust-style-guide skill: load .agents/skills/rust-style-guide (SKILL.md routes; policy files in .fabro/skills/rust-style-guide/guidelines*.md) before writing, reviewing, refactoring, or configuring Rust. Binding for upstream code, fork platform changes, and local features. In /iterate: Phase 1 grills/plans against the guide, Phase 2 loads guidelines.md + task pages before coding, Phase 3 standards axis IS the guide (workflows/code-review-refactor.md), Phase 4 judges deepening against enums-vs-traits/newtype/error-taxonomy/public-API pages. Deviations need the user plus an ADR.

name: pebble-skill-reference-binding-rule
description: Pebble (pinned rev 67c9f48) expand_skill binds a skill reference ONLY for tokens: '/' at input start or after whitespace + first char ascii lowercase + following chars [a-z0-9_-] + terminated by whitespace or END OF INPUT. Tokens ending at '/', ',', backtick, '*', ')' etc. do NOT bind (/api/v1/* and backticked instances are safe). TWO OR MORE bound tokens fail with MultipleReferences even when both are known. With skills=discover, any UNKNOWN bound token is a structural session killer ('expanding a skill reference', 0 tokens, <1s). Night 2026-09-19/20: 5 develop runs died at the reviewer stage on a single '/install ' inside the RAW fabro-b03f seed description — the planner brief is backticked, but reviewer embeds the raw tracker body. Static prompts are pinned by fork_seam_tests::workflow_prompts_carry_no_expandable_slash_tokens; the tracker-data arm is tracked in fabro-846b.
